videos.title: 573 - How many people can build a deployment pipeline without an agent?
videos.description:
573 - "How many people can build a deployment pipeline without an agent, by themselves, right now?" The code isn't complicated. Knowing every setting is, and that's what blocks whole organizations.

https://youtu.be/9_ssMBFK9GE

#microsoftfabric #ai #devops #deployment

videos.title: 573 - You don't need GitHub Actions experience to build this
videos.description:
573 - There's YAML behind the canvas, but you build the whole thing in the UI. That's the difference for most people. No GitHub Actions background required to get started.

https://youtu.be/9_ssMBFK9GE

#microsoftfabric #deployment #yaml #lowcode

videos.title: 573 - Deployment pipelines never covered your data
videos.description:
573 - Deployments have three layers: the item, the code inside the item, and the data. Pipelines handle the first two. There has never been data deployment, and that gap is the point.

https://youtu.be/9_ssMBFK9GE

#microsoftfabric #deployment #devops #dataengineering

videos.title: 573 - That deployment bug is really a lineage bug
videos.description:
573 - That empty-table failure gets blamed on deployment pipelines. It's a lineage problem. Microsoft is more or less admitting lineage only shows metadata, and that's the whole case for deployment plans.

https://youtu.be/9_ssMBFK9GE

#microsoftfabric #lineage #deployment #dataengineering

videos.title: 573 - Lineage won't tell you the table is still empty
videos.description:
573 - Lineage shows the warehouse view points at a lakehouse table. It never tells you the table is empty until a notebook runs. Deploy in lineage order and it fails every time.

https://youtu.be/9_ssMBFK9GE

#microsoftfabric #lineage #deployment #lakehouse

videos.title: 573 - Deployment pipelines fell off once Git became the standard
videos.description:
573 - Deployment pipelines quietly fell off once Git became the standard in Fabric workspaces. Two flows that never fit together. Deployment plans work more like repo actions, and that's the part worth hearing.

https://youtu.be/9_ssMBFK9GE

#microsoftfabric #git #deployment #dataengineering

videos.title: 573 - The parent pipeline fails if the child deploys later
videos.description:
573 - Child pipelines have to exist before the parent deploys, or the parent has nothing to attach to and the deploy fails. That order has been happening on its own, with nobody controlling it.

https://youtu.be/9_ssMBFK9GE

#microsoftfabric #devops #datapipelines #deployment

videos.title: 573 - I won't hand people Fabric if I can't turn things off
videos.description:
573 - "I'm not willing to give people Fabric because I can't turn off Dataflows Gen 2." Right now anyone with access can run anything in there. Policies finally change who gets to build what.

https://youtu.be/9_ssMBFK9GE

#microsoftfabric #governance #powerbi #dataplatform

videos.title: 573 - Capacity admins can now block who creates Dataflows Gen2
videos.description:
573 - Capacity admins can now say which security groups are allowed to create Dataflows Gen2, and where. Fabric policies in preview move governance off tenant-wide settings. Requests outside the rules get blocked.

https://youtu.be/9_ssMBFK9GE

#microsoftfabric #governance #dataplatform #powerbi

videos.title: 573 - Dashboards got a B minus, just above distressed
videos.description:
573 - Dashboards landed at a B minus, one notch above distressed. Four things set the score, and the last one is the question of whether anyone still uses the feature.

https://youtu.be/9_ssMBFK9GE

#microsoftfabric #powerbi #dashboards #datatools

videos.description:

This makes it easier for users to manage how their calls are handled without needing to switch to the desktop experience.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: AI-generated meeting memory for knowledge retention (formerly AI-generated meeting archive)
items.description: Teams will store AI-generated meeting memory files for meetings where Intelligent Recap was turned on, allowing Copilot (and Facilitator) to retain key insights from meetings beyond transcript retention periods and when a transcript was not saved. This enables Copilot to continue answering questions about past meetings even after the transcript expires or the meeting is over. Admins can also configure how long this AI-generated meeting memory file is stored.
